description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserConfigs operation to query configurations related to security features
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnUserConfigs查询安全功能相关的配置
name: DescribeDcdnUserConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The configuration to query. You can query the following configurations:

domain_business_control: User configurations.

bot_basic: Bot Traffic Management Basic Edition (legitimate web crawlers and threat intelligence).

bot_Advance: Bot Traffic Management Pro (legitimate web crawlers, threat intelligence, and AI-powered protection)
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的配置，支持查询的配置如下：

domain_business_control：用户配置。

bot_basic：机器流量管理基础版 （合法爬虫，威胁情报）。

bot_Advance：机器流量管理高级版（合法爬虫，威胁情报，AI智能防护）
parameters.name: function_name

ArgName.description_en:
The name of the configuration.

This parameter is related to configurations for enterprise users
ArgName.description_zh:

政企用户相关配置

ArgValue.description_en:
The value of the configuration. Valid values:

cc_rule: CC attack protection rules.

ddos_dispatch: DDoS scheduling with filter interaction.

edge_safe: Edge application security.

blocked_regions: Location blacklist.

http_acl_policy: Accurate Access Control.

bot_manager: Bot Traffic Management.

ip_reputation: IP reputation library
